Stochastic Analysis of Stages of a Road Surface Reconstruction Algorithm
We study a problem arising when one wants to automatically classify different textures from photographic images. The goal to be achieved is the complete elimination of ambiguities for a specific class of textures and an accurate determination of its most important features, such as size, shape and position of a texture.
